name: Chtonien 1
description: Mystique ancien lisant les runes prédisant les événements futurs et permettant des anticipations tactiques surprenantes.

subject.archetype: Chtonien 1 — Éveil Chthonien Common class faille_dimensionnelle

loadout.armor_outfit: Ancient ceremonial armor fused to wearer's body through dark ritual, shadowy fabric etched with independently shifting runic patterns casting purple light, living shadow tendrils writhing from shoulder guards with own consciousness, armor plates absorbing light instead of reflecting creating void patches
loadout.arsenal: Massive ritual staff taller than wielder inscribed with independently rotating forbidden symbols, shadow-manipulation artifact orbiting hand like dark satellite with void energy tendrils connecting to body, cursed amulets chained to armor pulsating with green phosphor light emitting foul energy wisps Functional combat equipment showing signs of heavy practical use and field customization

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Combat stance with weapon or tool raised and ready, eyes locked on approaching threat, body coiled like a spring ready to explode into action
attitude.emotion: Focused determination — seasoned professional locked in the moment of combat

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Deep Void Purple
palette_names.role: primary_accent — shadow energy emanation and tentacle glow

palette_names.name: Bone White
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — skeletal remains and carved runes

palette_names.name: Eerie Green Phosphor
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — forbidden energy arcs and corruption

color_and_light.lighting_setup: brushed steel utility frame, simple geometric corner markers, no ornamentation, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Eye-level medium shot capturing face and primary action clearly, shallow depth of field, motion freeze at peak of action

scenography.setting: Torn dimensional battlefield with ground splitting open in massive fissures as enormous shadow tentacles erupt from below, sky showing impossible geometry and wrongness human mind cannot process, ancient runes blazing on every surface as dimensions collapse, reality thinning and tearing at edges, thick oppressive atmosphere of supernatural dread
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Tension and lethal potential visible in every tensed muscle — combat readiness radiating from posture and grip on weapon, Active combat zone with explosions and engagements around the character, allies and enemies locked in fierce battle, chaos of war as backdrop, Massive shadow tentacles erupting from cracked ground grasping at sky, dimensional rifts tearing open revealing impossible non-Euclidean geometry with wrong colors, floating forbidden runes spinning violently in dark purple energy maelstrom, skeletal remains rattling and rising from earth, void essence fog rolling across ground like creeping tsunami
